DIAGNOSIS READY: Lung Cancer (Small Cell or Non-Small Cell)

The patient's presentation of significant unintentional weight loss (18.1 kg), fatigue, and malaise over six months is highly concerning for malignancy. Given his age and the constitutional symptoms, I suspect a primary lung tumor or other thoracic malignancy. I will proceed with imaging to evaluate the lungs and mediastinum immediately. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest CT with contrast.
